fusions.name: Saw It First
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away. The strike deals 16 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Darting Glance
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Between Two Blinks
fusions.desc: After a 0.3-second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, then leaves them [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Afterimage
fusions.desc: Whenever you inflict a condition, a bolt strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 9 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
